prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: The one time someone convinces me to take a  flight, it's delayed 4 hours!
Delta: Oh no! I'm sorry to hear that. Are you needing assistance with your flights? *AMC

Customer: Yesterday on board  flight didn't get beer I requested for half hour and then again after reminding a (rather rude) flight attendant.
Delta: I'm so sorry to hear that Anil; please accept my apology and know that we expect our flight attendants to be courteous at all times.  *TMB

Customer: Why is it that every time I fly with  they make me sit on the run way for at least a half hour before I can get off the plane. 🤬literally every time
Delta: Hey Wayne, I'm sorry that is not our goal. Can you DM your confirmation # to the link provided? I will get you an update.  *TBT https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Why am i not superised that yet again another  flight is delayed over 2 hours...you would have thought I’d have learned my lesson by now. #unahppycustomer
Delta: I hate to learn you were inconvenienced. My apologies for the delay. Do you need to check for alternate flights? If so, pls follow/DM your confirmation. *HEC

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

""". why was flight 5869 delayed for two hours and then we have just been sitting here for half an hour? Unacceptable"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Sorry for the delay, we understand it’s frustrating. Please DM us your confirmation # so we can look into flight 5869 and get you an update. *HEC
